explication: Clone Wars is a curated directory of open-source clones and alternatives, not the implementations of those products. Readers browse two catalogs, then use each listing’s demo, tutorial, repository, and technology details to evaluate or study a project. The README also invites contributors to keep the list current. The supplied tree and excerpts expose no implementation code, so this graph reflects only documented catalog structure and links.
